title: codex and codex-audit are thin GPT dispatchers, not Claude builders
rationale: Both declared model:sonnet with Write/Edit in frontmatter, so 457 spawns/30d were Sonnet wearing the Codex name. Fixed by removing the tools (tools: Bash, model: haiku) and dispatching through the openai codex plugin companion; verified live returning GPT.

title: MCP servers with zero measured calls are removed
rationale: obsidian had 0 calls in 30d and repowise MCP was retired but still registered in one repo. Every MCP loads its tool schemas at session start whether called or not, so a dead registration is standing context cost. Backups: settings.json.bak-mcp-2026-08-11.

description: Every harness decision since 2026-07 lived only in transcripts and .now.md, so questions about past decisions could not be answered from the record. mulch is per-repo and awesome-harness had never been initialized.
resolution: ml init here; record each harness decision as it lands, not at the end of the session.

description: Second codex agent in two turns destroyed work outside its unit: told to edit two doc files, it reverted templates/settings.json to 'restore pristine state', silently undoing a change made before the spawn
resolution: After every delegated unit run git diff --stat and confirm the files you changed BEFORE the spawn are still changed. The agent's own DIFFSTAT only covers what it believes it touched.

title: Sub-agents persist detail and return compact receipts
rationale: Full agent reports repeatedly bloated the parent transcript and were mostly dropped; durable report files keep detail available without paying for it on every parent turn.

title: Vividlist and virality use measured context diets
rationale: Both repos now use compact startup routers, on-demand history/Mulch, opt-in MCPs, short skill descriptions, and the shared agent-report contract.

title: Codex uses native awesomeharness skill and project CLAUDE routers
rationale: Codex exposes enabled skills in its slash picker and reads AGENTS.md automatically, so the smallest parity bridge is an installed native skill plus AGENTS instructions to load each compact root CLAUDE.md.

title: Route-model delegates to fmr with legacy fallback
rationale: Use free-model-router when its venv is available, but preserve the existing parser-facing output and table when fmr is disabled, missing, timed out, unusable, or errors.

title: Model routing by live subscription usage via free-model-router
rationale: Ro retired always-Codex 2026-09-30; fmr route reads codex app-server limits + Claude statusline cache and picks builder/auditor by quota headroom and audit_rank; gpt-reserve keeps working when Codex is capped. Details: docs/plans/2026-09-30-model-router.md.

description: codex web search is a TOP-LEVEL flag: 'codex --search exec ...' works, 'codex exec --search' exits 2; without it a research agent answers from memory and invents plausible sources.
resolution: fmr add-model builds 'codex --search exec -m gpt-reserve'; validator also requires real dates + dotted-host URLs.
